home.heroTitle: The Arab Summit for Digital Economy Skills
home.heroBody: Two days. Four live income tracks. Hundreds of participants trained on the internet skills that let anyone start earning online, no office, no degree, no capital required.
home.summitTitle: Two days. Real skills, real income tracks.
home.summitBody: Participants go through a full rotation across four hands-on tracks led by working practitioners, not lecturers. Every participant leaves with a functioning setup in at least one track: a store, a content channel, a client pipeline, or a live AI-powered service.
home.summitParticipants: Participants, grouped for full rotation across all tracks
home.day1Body: 9:00 opening plenary — sponsor and government addresses — then training rotation across Affiliate Marketing, E-commerce, AI & Vibe Coding, and Sales Skills through 16:40.
home.day2Body: Training rotation continues from 9:30, closing with certificate handover and sponsor recognition at the 16:00 graduation ceremony.
home.trainersEyebrow: Learn from people who are actually doing it

aboutPage.metaDescription: Why Intaleq exists: the digital economy skills gap it closes, and the model behind the Arab Summit for Digital Economy Skills.
aboutPage.heroTitle: A real gap. A real solution.
aboutPage.heroBody: Intaleq is the platform behind Muntaliq, the Arab Summit for Digital Economy Skills. It exists because free content and scattered one-off courses haven't actually prepared youth for the global digital economy.
aboutPage.modelTitle: Built to outlast its own funding.
aboutPage.modelBody: Muntaliq is modeled on ArabNet: a self-sustaining annual summit, with an Amman plenary that funds and anchors a hands-on training week. Once the model is proven, it's built to expand to other cities and governorates.
aboutPage.plenaryBody: The annual Muntaliq plenary in Amman — panels, keynotes, and digital economy practitioners in one room, one day.
aboutPage.trainingBody: A hands-on training week in Amman, in partnership with Jordan Bromine Company, across seven digital income tracks.

tracksPage.metaDescription: Seven digital income tracks across three worlds — Sell, Create, Build — taught hands-on in Amman.
tracksPage.heroBody: Pick one track. Spend a week building the skill, the product, and the first client or sale that makes it real.

trainersPage.metaDescription: Meet the practitioners leading Muntaliq 2026's hands-on training tracks.
trainersPage.heroBody: Every trainer at Muntaliq is actively working in the field they teach — not presenting theory, but the exact process they use to earn from it.
trainersPage.ctaTitle: Are you a practitioner in a digital income field?
trainersPage.ctaBody: Muntaliq is looking to expand its trainer bench for future cohorts.

partnersPage.metaDescription: Partner with Muntaliq 2026 — the Arab Summit for Digital Economy Skills. Sponsorship tiers and measurable impact.
partnersPage.heroTitle: Tie your name to the region's biggest digital economy skills gathering.
partnersPage.heroBody: An annual Arab summit with measurable impact: number of participants trained, income generated, projects actually launched.

tiers.name: Anchor Partner
tiers.body: Top billing across the plenary and training week, a speaking slot in Amman, and co-branding on the training site.

tiers.name: Track Sponsor
tiers.body: Your name attached to one of the seven digital income tracks, with participant outcomes reported back for that track specifically.

tiers.name: In-Kind Partner
tiers.body: Provide space, equipment, logistics, or trainer time in exchange for recognition across all Muntaliq 2026 materials.
